notes: MERIDIAN v2 FLYING HEADER, No.7 (project "No.7"): the shared No.10 body re-skinned (skin #d69668/#b06e4a/#74422c, his own short dark crop #463428/#281c16, yellow "7"), same scale (98 px standing, ground row 102). Side view, facing east, not mirrored (no west strip). H1 is a ground frame on the push (left, far) toe contact (52,102), shot 7 0.80-0.95. H1b sits on the same toe pixel only 0.95-0.98, then is AIRBORNE by pelvis (71,64) on the rising take-off arc (frame.arc: s7 0.98-1.20 dx = 10u, dy = -14(1.4286u - 0.4286u^2), u = (t-0.98)/0.22; s8 0.00-0.10 dx = 10 + 45.45t, dy = -14 - 36.36t; sprite px at x1, +x forward). H2, H3, H3b, H4 are airborne by pelvis; H5 lies on the turf: contact = the chest-on-turf pixel (59,102) (chest = (71,102) the sternum on the turf), lowest row 102. forehead = the brow-front point the ball touches (the game places the ball touching it): H1 (87,21), H1b (101,33), H2 (99,57), H3/H3b (103,58), H4 (99,43). H1b -> H2 hand-off (shot 8 0.10, brief production note): forehead - pelvis is (+30,-31) on H1b and (+47,-9) on H2, so head-lock the swap: place H2 with pelvis = H1b forehead (world) - (47,-9), then ease the pelvis offset back onto the planned path over 0.10-0.18 (outCubic) so H3 still meets the ball at 0.36. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Shot 7: H1 0.80-0.95 (x1), H1b 0.95-1.20. Shot 8 (x2): H1b 0.00-0.10, H2 0.10-0.36, H3 0.36-0.40, H3b 0.40-0.58 (hit-stop), H3 0.58-0.62, H4 0.62-0.80, H5 0.80-1.00 (and behind the bead). Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot/forehead. Studio: No.7 / Header / Side (Front/Back views blank).
